User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account within the application.

role.description: The user's role in the application.

wishlist.description: An array of property IDs that the user has added to their wishlist.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was last updated.

Property.title: Property
Property.description: Represents a real estate property listed in the application.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns the property.

address.description: The full address of the property.

price.description: The listing price of the property.

status.description: The current status of the property.

brokerage.description: The commission percentage offered to the broker.

brokerId.description: The UID of the broker assigned to this property.

brokerAssignmentStatus.description: The status of the broker's assignment to the property.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the property was listed.

Deal.title: Deal
Deal.description: Represents a transaction or deal for a property.

dealId.description: The unique identifier for the deal.

propertyId.description: The ID of the property this deal is for.

status.description: The current status of the deal.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the deal was initiated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles, with path-based ownership for security.

/deals/{dealId}.description: Contains all deals related to properties.

/roles_admin/{userId}.description: A collection of admin user IDs, used for role-based access control. Existence in this collection grants admin privileges.
